Name: Spring Fertility Dance
Author: bezajel
Description:
This mod is based on original concept and sprite edits by supercarlfragilemystic, with sprite refinement and CP code by bezajel.

The bachelorettes will now lift their skirts at the flower dance.


[b][size=4]How to install:
[/size][/b]
Unzip and place in your Mods folder.


[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]:
[/size]
Because sprites are based on vanilla sprite design and flower dance clothing, this mod is not compatible with any mod that changes bachelorettes base character design (skin colour or hair), or the flower dance dresses, unless changes to bachelorettes are disabled in the other mod.

The mod is compatible with mods that only change clothing other than the flower dance dresses, without making changes to the base character, and targeting Vanilla assets only.

The mod is compatible with expansions, but only the vanilla bachelorettes will lift their skirts.


[size=4][b]Future Development:
[/b][/size]
* Config to choose which bachelorettes flash, for greater compatibility options.
* SVE bachelorettes, subject to permissions.
* Improved compatibility with the appearances system



Enjoy!
